name: Alta S.A.
summary: Operating through its various subsidiary entities, Alta S.A. is deeply involved in the real estate sector across Poland. The company's diverse operations include leasing commercial, logistical, and office properties, as well as acquiring, preparing, and divesting land plots for development. Furthermore, it undertakes the construction and sale of residential properties, such as houses and apartments, and offers comprehensive real estate administration services. The Warsaw, Poland-based firm was previously known as TUP Spólka Akcyjna, officially changing its name to Alta S.A. in September 2013. Alta S.A. functions as a subsidiary of Hlamata Holdings Limited.
